subject: Partner onboarding: model weights distribution & licensing terms
messages:
From: Tom Reed <tom.reed@openmodlabs.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: licenses@openmodlabs.ai
Date: Sat, 2 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Opportunity: distributing OpenMod weights via Redwood

Hi Jonas,

We ran into Redwood at KubeCon and followed your talk on inference routing — congrats on the product. OpenMod Labs has two mid-size open models (OML-Base-1 / OML-Instruct-1) we are preparing for wider distribution and we'd love to explore making Redwood an approved host and distributor for our weights.

High-level ask: evaluate feasibility of hosting and serving our weights under a controlled-distribution license (we want to allow inference via hosted APIs and Dedicated customers but restrict downstream checkpoint rehosting / public redistribution).

I've attached a draft partner term sheet and model spec for initial review. Would love to schedule a short call to run through technical constraints (quantization compatibility, fingerprinting, watermark requirements) and commercial terms.

Thanks,
Tom Reed
Head of Ecosystem, OpenMod Labs
partnerships@openmodlabs.ai

Attachments: OML_partner_terms_v1.pdf (PDF, 240KB), OML_model_spec_v1.json (JSON, 95KB)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reed <tom.reed@openmodlabs.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, licenses@openmodlabs.ai
Date: Sat, 2 May 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Opportunity: distributing OpenMod weights via Redwood

Tom — great to meet you at KubeCon and thanks for reaching out. Forwarding to Marissa (partnerships lead) and cc-ing licensing for the legal side.

Quick answers up front: Redwood can host models under configurable distribution policies — we already support per-model distribution flags and can prevent outbound weights export from Dedicated pools. However, we need to understand the details of the license restrictions you have in mind and whether they require runtime telemetry, watermarking, or any special KMS/HSM protections.

I propose a 30-minute sync next week (Mon/Tue windows). Also looping in Vivek from Infrastructure to confirm any infra-level constraints.

Can you share: 1) the specific redistribution clause you want enforced, 2) whether you require cryptographic attestations or FP32 checksum tracking, and 3) your expected SLA & supported regions?

—Jonas
Head of Partnerships (Go-to-Market), Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@openmodlabs.ai>
Cc: licenses@openmodlabs.ai, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Opportunity: distributing OpenMod weights via Redwood

Tom — thanks for the packet. Reviewing it now. A couple of commercial/legal items that typically surface for weight distribution partners:

- We need a clear export-control & redistribution clause that allows inference while prohibiting model checkpoint downloads by end customers or third parties.
- Our Legal will want an indemnity carveout around data exfiltration; can you confirm whether OML requires any specific telemetry from the host for usage reporting?
- Commercial: are you proposing rev-share, fixed distribution fee, or a hybrid? Please include target list pricing so we can model margin impact.

Technical questions for our infra/product teams:
- Are you expecting us to implement watermarking or fingerprinting at the inference layer, or would you provide a watermarking tool to embed into the model pre-release?
- Quantization profile: do your weights support int8/4 quantization without accuracy cliffs? The attached model_spec indicates fp16 baseline but we need quantization guidance.

We have an onboarding checklist that covers legal/tech/risk. I attached a draft checklist below.

Proposed next step: 30-min call Wednesday 5/6 10:00am PT. Does that work?

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_onboarding_checklist.xlsx

From: Tom Reed <tom.reed@openmodlabs.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: licenses@openmodlabs.ai
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Opportunity: distributing OpenMod weights via Redwood

Marissa / team — appreciate the swift review. Quick answers inline: 

- Redistribution clause: OpenMod is proposing a Controlled Redistribution License (CRL) that permits inference and model hosting but forbids downstream checkpoint export or re-publication. We can provide contract language.
- Telemetry: we prefer aggregated usage metrics for royalties, not raw tokens. No PII/UTK-level telemetry required.
- Commercial: we’re thinking revenue share on inference usage (tiered) + a nominal per-model listing fee. I attached v1 of the term sheet with suggested splits.
- Watermarking: OML currently embeds a lightweight statistical watermark prior to distribution; we can provide the embedding tool and verification library. We do request that hosts retain verification metadata for audit for 12 months.
- Quantization: all OML models are validated for int8 and int4 with recommended quantization configs; the model_spec includes quantization vectors.

Happy to sign an NDA/term sheet. We can also do an initial pilot with OML-Base-1 on Redwood Hosted with limits to validate performance.

Best,
Tom

Attachments: OML_partner_terms_v1.pdf (updated)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, licenses@openmodlabs.ai
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Opportunity: distributing OpenMod weights via Redwood — internal next steps

Team — forwarding thread and the OML packet. Proposed internal plan:

1) Stephanie, can you own a pilot onboarding plan for OML-Base-1 (Hosted only) to validate quantization + watermark verification? Deliverables: micro-benchmark (p95 latency delta vs baseline), cost per 1M tokens, and verification log storage plan.
2) Vivek, please validate Dedicated pool constraints: can we enforce "no weights-export" at the infra level and what changes for audit retention if they require 12mo verification metadata?
3) Legal (licenses@) — please prepare a redline of the CRL and confirm whether revenue share needs specific accounting hooks.

Tom offered an initial pilot and revenue-share + listing fee. If pilot looks good, Marissa and I will negotiate a commercial pilot MOU and a follow-on distribution agreement.

—Jonas
Head of Partnerships
